page_title: Candela: Display Health and OLED Protection for Mac

sources.entry: Candela - Display care for external monitors: OLED burn-in protection, panel health history, and everyday brightness, volume, and contrast controls. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/Rydersel/Candela) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] ![Native App][Native Icon]

summary.name: Candela
summary.one_liner: Candela is a free, open-source macOS app that protects OLED displays from burn-in, checks monitors for defects and wear, and adds brightness, volume and contrast controls for external displays.
use_cases: Reduce burn-in risk on an OLED monitor used for static toolbars
Control brightness, volume and contrast of external monitors from the Mac
Check a display for defects and wear and keep a report
Add scaled HiDPI resolutions System Settings does not list
Keep a Mac awake-display session from the menu bar
Create a virtual display for a headless Mac
summary.what_it_does: Candela dims an enrolled OLED when the user steps away and can ease down bright, unchanged screen regions while leaving active content at full brightness. It keeps a local exposure grid of where the panel has been lit, with optional measured brightness from screen sampling, and attributes display time by app without reading window contents. Checkups produce a report separating what the monitor reports, what Candela observes, and what the user confirms visually, and the panel record can be exported as an integrity-checked file. It also provides menu bar and keyboard control of brightness, volume, contrast and mute for external displays, plus extra scaled resolutions, mirroring, rotation, refresh rate, virtual displays and a keep-awake option.
notable: Free and open source under MIT license, with no paid tier stated
Local-only: no account, no telemetry, no upload of screen samples
Lists scaled HiDPI resolutions that System Settings does not show, with safe rollback
Panel health checkup separates monitor claims, observed results and user confirmation
caveats: Requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later on Apple Silicon Mac
Some docks and adapters block the display control connections Candela needs
Measured exposure sampling requires Screen Recording permission; Accessibility is needed for keyboard brightness and volume keys on external displays
